description: Snap co-founder Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr have donated $550 million to erase medical debt. This significant contribution will benefit over 261,000 Californians facing financial hardship. The donation follows a philanthropic model pioneered by MacKenzie Scott. Undue Medical Debt will administer the funds, targeting vulnerable residents statewide. This initiative aims to unburden families from unpayable medical expenses.

title: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's $2m gift moves families of fallen NYC heroes
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's generosity has brought heartfelt reactions from families of fallen New York City heroes who have long relied on Answer The Call for support. Widows and children shared emotional messages, with one saying, "I am in tears," while thanking the couple for their kindness. The donation is part of the couple's wider charitable efforts ahead of their wedding, but what touched these families most was the reassurance that the sacrifices of their loved ones will never be forgotten thanks to the couple's $2 million gift.

title: Patrick, Brittany Mahomes turn family pain into food allergy awareness
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes attended a back-to-school event with FARE just before Chiefs training camp, continuing their advocacy for food allergy awareness. The couple's mission comes from personal experience after their children, Sterling and Bronze, were diagnosed with food allergies. Brittany has previously shared the frightening details of Bronze's severe allergic reaction and how it inspired the family to help others. Here's how Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are using their platform to support parents and create safer environments for children with food allergies.
